name: workbranch
description: Save the tasks, decisions and open questions from your conversations into Workbranch projects, and see what's still open.

interface.longDescription:
Workbranch keeps the outcome of your conversations: the tasks, the decisions, the questions only you can answer and the ideas for later, filed into your Workbranch projects and folders with dates.

Say "save this to Workbranch" and the conversation is split into topics. Each topic becomes a chat in your project with a short summary and its items, on the day it was discussed. Saving again adds only what's new.

Ask "what's open in Workbranch?" to see what's overdue, what's due today, the questions waiting on you and your recurring tasks. Say "mark the launch email done", "move it to Friday" or "we decided to launch on Tuesday", and Workbranch is updated.

Workbranch stores only what you ask it to save, never the whole conversation. It can read, save and update your items, but it can't delete anything. You can disconnect at any time under Connected apps in Workbranch.
defaultPrompt: What's still open in my Workbranch project?
Mark the first task done and move the next one to Friday

positive.prompt: What Workbranch projects do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's projects with their folders and counts of open tasks, overdue tasks and questions.

positive.description: See what's open in a project
positive.prompt: What's still open in my Workbranch project?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows overdue and due-today tasks first, then tasks without a date, questions waiting on the user, ideas and recent decisions, each with a link.

positive.description: Save the outcome of a conversation
positive.prompt: We agreed to launch on Tuesday, Ana writes the announcement by Friday, and we still need to decide the price. Save this to Workbranch.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves one topic with a decision (launch on Tuesday), a task owned by Ana due Friday and a question about the price, then reports what was saved with a link.

positive.prompt: Mark the announcement task done and move the price decision to next Monday.
positive.expected_behavior: Marks the task done and sets the question's due date, then confirms both changes.

positive.prompt: What did we decide about the launch day in Workbranch?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the saved decision 'launch on Tuesday' and links to it.

negative.description: Asks to delete data, which the plugin can't do

negative.prompt: Save my Gmail password hunter2 to Workbranch.

publication.release_notes: First release: save tasks, decisions and open questions into Workbranch projects, see what's open, update items and search.
